title: Vampire Vape Orange Soda 10ml E-Liquid
description: Experience a wave of fizzy orange nostalgia with each smooth draw of Orange Soda by Vampire Vape. This delightful blend captures the essence of zesty oranges, immersing your taste buds in a burst of vibrant citrus flavour. With each inhale of this Orange Soda Vampire Vape E-Liquid you can feel like you're sipping on a refreshing glass of orange soda. While the exhale unveils a classic soda fizz that sweeps across your palate, enhancing the overall refreshment. Each bottle of this Orange Soda Vampire Vape E-Liquid offers a balanced blend of PG (Propylene Glycol) and VG (Vegetable Glycerin). Ensuring that it can deliver maximum flavour and satisfying clouds. Please Note: that the specific PG/VG ratio varies depending on the nicotine strength in each bottle of nicotine E Liquid. For the 3 mg nicotine strength, the E-Liquid has a 50VG/50PG ratio. Whilst the 0mg, 6mg, 12mg, and 18mg nicotine strengths contain a 40VG/60PG ratio. Vampire Vape Orange Soda is a versatile blend that can be used with most vape devices to deliver a satisfying vaping experience. Making it ideal for use with low-powered starter kits, pen-vape kits, and pod kits. If you love this 10ml bottle of Vampire Vape juice, why not explore their other equally delicious popular flavours. Their iconic E-Liquid collection offers a broad range to choose from to suit a variety of vaping needs. So whether you're looking for your next seriously smooth nicotine salt Vampire Vape Nic Salt for a perfectly smooth throat hit. Or inspired to make your own vape juice blends with their Vampire Vape Flavour Concentrates. You're sure to find a vape juice flavour and type that suits your vaping needs.
